title: Austin Picks New City Manager in Emergency Session
summary:
*   Austin leaders convened an urgent, special meeting to address city leadership.
*   Following executive discussions, Jorge Carrasco was officially appointed as Austin's new City Manager.
*   Carrasco's annual salary was approved at $89,500.

EMERGENCY SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Mullen called
to order the Emergency Special Called Meeting of the Council scheduled for 4:00 p.m.,
noting the presence of all Councilmembers. Mayor Mullen announced Council will go into
Executive Session pursuant to Article 6252-17 to meet with Jorge Carrasco about the
position of City Manager, pursuant to Section 2, Paragraph g, Personnel and that any
action to be taken as a result of such closed or executive session will be done in open
meeting.
RECESS
Council. recessed its meeting for the Executive Session and later resumed its recessed
meeting.
ΑΡΡΟΙΝΤMENT OF CITY MANAGER
The Council, on Mayor Pro Tem Trevino's motion, Councilmember Rose's second, approved the
appointment of Jorge Carrasco as City Manager of Austin, Texas with an annual salary of
$89,500.00. (7-0 Vote)
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 7:17 p.m.
